about: A turn's `memory` field. Each case gives `now`, `timezone` (optional), `conversation` (the current one, or null), `message` (the user's latest, the query of pre-selection, its terms built as search_cases.json's about says, or null) and its own `corpus`: `conversations`, `rounds` and `facts` as in search_cases.json, and `entries` ({id, topic, text, updated_at, valid_until?, locked?}, locked false when left out). An incognito conversation's rounds are recorded first, as any other's; marking it then deletes them and its summary, and keeps its title. `expect` is turn_payload(message, exclude_conversation=conversation, timezone) at `now`: {status, entries, recent, recalled}, every list in order. A case without `timezone` runs in UTC; with one, each day (today, for expiry, each entry's updated_at, each conversation's last_active_at and each recalled date) is a day in that IANA zone. Every cap counts code points, and a list over a cap keeps the longest run of its items, in its order, that fits: an item that would fit after one that doesn't is left out too. `entries`: the visible ones still valid today (a valid_until before today has expired), as {id, topic, text, updated_at, valid_until?}, at most 40 and 6,000 of text, ranked for the caps locked first, then the most recently updated first, so unlocked entries are left out before locked ones, the least recently updated first; they are sent in the store's order. `recent`: the conversations most recently active first, but the current one and incognito ones, as {id, title, summary, last_active_at}, at most 8 and 3,000 of title and summary; the title is the conversation's, else its summary's, and one with neither is passed over before the caps are counted. `recalled`: the hits of a search for `message` (limit 8), best first, leaving out the current conversation's rounds and the facts drawn from it, that clear pre-selection's floor: a fused score of at least 1/64, and 2 units of the text, which for a round is its user_text and assistant_text without labels, and for a fact its text without the (until) prefix. Each CJK or Thai term of the query that the text holds is one unit, and the query's words make as many as a maximum matching pairs them with distinct words of the text that they begin, each word on either side in one pair at most. So the floor asks for two distinct matches in every script, and one query word that begins two words of the text counts once. Recalled hits are {kind, date, conversation_title, text}, at most 4 and 4,000 of conversation_title and text. A title is at most 120 code points, and an excerpt at most 614 with its ellipses and label, or 988 with the reply's second window (search_cases.json). 4 times (120 + 614) is 2,936, so the 4,000 can bind only when three or four hits have two windows: 3 times (120 + 988), plus 120 + 614, is 4,058. A fact with a valid_until reads "(until YYYY-MM-DD) " before its text, and one past it is still recalled: a fact stays true as history, and answers questions about the past. Python's MemoryStore.turn_payload replays every case on each backend (talk2view-python, tests/test_contract_memory.py).
